messages:
rachel: Heads-up — Nebula just flagged a manifest mismatch on reservation 112233. Their marketplace SKU IDs don't match our reserved SKU mapping, carrier put shipment on hold. ETA unknown. @devon @marco any quick ideas?

devon: ugh. which regions and committed pools?

rachel: us-east dedicated pool A and eu-west dev/dedicated mix. Two customer commits could be impacted.

marco: can we translate Nebula SKUs to our catalog with a mapping table? if it's a pure naming mismatch we can accept.

rachel: mapping mismatch + customs doc mismatch per Nebula. They say the proforma used old HS codes. Customs flagged it -> hold.

zara: do we have a backup supplier with open marketplace capacity for the same GPU SKUs?

marco: BlueAnchor has limited hot-swap inventory in eu-west but not enough for both customers. Could cover one customer fully.

rachel: Nebula offered to reissue manifest and expedite reclassification but timeline is +10 business days unless we accept a split delivery.

logistics-bot: manifest 112233 status -> ON_HOLD (reason: CUSTOMS_DOC_MISMATCH). Carrier ETA estimate -> +240h pending docs.

devon: propose plan: 1) try fast reclassification with Nebula (ask for corrected HS + digital docs) 2) reassign highest-priority customer to BlueAnchor temporary slot 3) open marketplace change ticket + notify sales/legal re SLA exposure.

rachel: agreed. I'm requesting corrected docs now. Tim (Nebula) can you escalate customs clearing and give a guaranteed ship-by date?

tim_nebula: (Nebula) on it. We can push customs brokerage priority and provide e-docs within 24h. If that clears we can aim for consolidated re-ship in 5 business days. Partial split available now if you accept different rack labels.

zara: need cost estimate for split + cross-dock handling if we accept partial now.

marco: quick calc: cross-dock + re-labeling + expedited customs = ~$6.5k; BlueAnchor temporary cover = ~$3k for reserved slot.

devon: ok, order of ops: a) rachel get Nebula e-docs within 24h b) zara confirm budget owner ok with ~$6.5k c) I open MP ticket and assign backup slot with BlueAnchor. If Nebula fails to deliver timeline we failover fully to BlueAnchor and invoice Nebula per SLA.

rachel: filing ticket: https://marketplace.internal/tickets/MP-44021 (manifest 112233 attached). Adding docs request to Nebula thread.

tim_nebula: uploaded provisional e-docs to share (awaiting signature). Will confirm customs broker on standby.

logistics-bot: ticket MP-44021 created and linked to manifest 112233.

rachel: action items: 
- rachel: collect Nebula e-docs and confirm broker ETA
- zara: secure budget approval for cross-dock cost if needed
- devon: reserve BlueAnchor emergency slot and prepare transition plan
- marco: draft customer comms for potential split + timeline

zara: noted. I'll ping finance for urgent approval.

devon: reserving BlueAnchor now, will post reservation id when done.

rachel: thanks all — will update here as soon as docs arrive. :memo:
